# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Reader = azure/gpt-5.5, tier STRONG-but-not-frontier → explicit imperative rule + a concrete
worked-format cue (the accounting number-format string) so the reader can pattern-match the case.

## Method / process
Fanned out 4 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents, one per group of ~5 failing
trajectories, to diagnose ALL 21 failing tasks by root cause and classify each as
CONTRACT/FORMAT vs genuine COMPUTATION-LOGIC vs AMBIGUITY vs ENVIRONMENT, and to say whether a
GENERAL, regression-safe prompt rule could fix it. I independently cross-read 50630, 325-44,
and 59259 (incl. the exact stored number_format) to confirm the one edit.

## Ranked issue list (clusters, biggest lever first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | VALUE / LOGIC ceiling | 53367, 3911, 11842, 57090, 56996(RANDBETWEEN), 325-44, 450-9, 39046, 51359, 55931, 56637 | genuine task-specific «redacted» semantics; often passes 1-2 copies, fails the others | CAPABILITY-GAP | SKIPPED — no general prose rule can encode task logic without leaking answers |
| 2 | AMBIGUOUS / INTERNALLY-INCONSISTENT spec or GT | 5192, 47741, 30709, 50630 | the two worked examples / GT across copies are mutually contradictory; the hidden rule is unrecoverable | AMBIGUITY | SKIPPED — underdetermined; a rule would be a guess |
| 3 | Instruction-named-literal "-" written as STRING where GT is numeric 0 | **59259** | cand_0002's "output result may be '-' → write literal '-'" rule fires, but GT stores int 0 with an ACCOUNTING number_format that DISPLAYS 0 as "-"; "11 cells hold str where int expected" | CONTRACT / CONFLICT | **FIXED (this iteration)** |
| — | ENVIRONMENT / infra | 73-45 | scorer feedback itself: formula recalc FAILED, stale cached values; agent used literal rich-text (no formula dependency) — harness fault, "do not optimize against it" | ENVIRONMENT | HANDED BACK — not a prompt defect |
| — | Type-miss on EMPTY target (no worked-example anchor) | 51958, 56427, 57232 | date/number written as text | CONTRACT (partial) | SKIPPED — each carries an orthogonal non-prose blocker (year undetermined / segmentation logic / match-logic) so a type rule flips NONE of them to passing → fails the VERIFIED test, and a broad "make numbers real numbers" rule risks stripping text IDs (a known regression class) |

## Change made this iteration (1 edit)
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | CONTRACT + CONFLICT-resolution (narrowing) | task_template.md | Narrow the instruction-named-literal bullet: a "-" is usually the DISPLAY of a numeric 0 under an accounting number_format (`_-* #,##0_-;...;_-* "-"??_-;...`). Inspect the target/worked-example cell — if it stores a NUMBER (data_type 'n') or its number_format has a "-" accounting section, write the numeric value (0) and KEEP the format; write the literal string "-" only when the worked-example cell actually stores that string. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the edit changes on those exact inputs)
- 59259: worked-example cells J5:L10 store **int 0** with number_format
  `_-* #,##0_-;\-* #,##0_-;_-* "-"??_-;_-@_-` (confirmed from the trace's own inspection). The
  instruction says "output result may be '-'", so under cand_0002's rule the agent wrote the
  **string** "-" for every zero → feedback "11 cell(s) hold str where int was expected". The
  narrowed rule makes the agent recognize the accounting format / numeric example cell and write
  numeric **0** with the format preserved — the exact type the grader compares. The dash was only
  the display. (Residual caveat: there may also be a secondary logic question on rows 11–16's
  reporting-month cutoff; the type fix removes the explicit, dominant TYPE error either way.)

## Blast-radius / SAFE (BOUNDED-additive, conflict resolved toward the already-authoritative rule)
The edit fires ONLY when (a) the instruction names "-" as a possible result AND (b) the
target/worked-example cell stores a number or has a "-" accounting number_format. It changes no
global decision/permission rule; it resolves a conflict between two existing template rules in
favor of the worked-example STORED TYPE (which the template already treats as authoritative).
- No passing task can currently pass by writing the string "-" over a numeric/accounting cell:
  if GT there were the string "-", the worked-example cell would store data_type 's' and the rule
  still writes "-"; if GT were numeric 0, cand_0002's old "write '-'" rule would already FAIL it,
  so it cannot be a currently-passing task. Hence no passing trajectory flips.
- The #N/A half of the rule is UNTOUCHED (57232 writes #N/A correctly; its failure is match-logic).
- Consistent with MEMORY regression traps: no whitespace strip, no XML/formula/CF restructure, no
  "text must be str" flatten (protects 73-45's rich text).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Clusters 1 & 2 (≈15 tasks): genuine computation/reshape/matching-logic or internally-inconsistent
  spec/GT. Prose cannot encode task-specific logic without hardcoding the answer (fails NON-OVERFIT).
  Evidence: several pass copy 1 and fail copies 2/3 with identical code (data-dependent ceiling).
- 73-45: ENVIRONMENT (recalc failed); handed back per the scorer's own instruction.
- 50630 (datetime-where-str on a split task): the agent ALREADY replicated the worked-example
  per-column type (D→str, E→datetime) yet still scored 0/3, so the failure is not a clean
  type-only miss; and a "split tasks keep fragments as string" rule would directly CONFLICT with
  the accepted "replicate worked-example type" rule (E5 is itself a datetime) → unsafe. Dropped.
- Empty-target type rule (51958/56427/57232): flips no task to passing (orthogonal blockers) →
  fails VERIFIED; broad numeric-coercion risks stripping text IDs → fails SAFE. Dropped.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo)
- Keep the accounting-format discriminator: "-" is usually a formatted numeric 0, not a string.
- Never re-add "text answer must be str" / "keep extracted text as text" → flattens rich text (73-45).
- Never re-add "simplest reading / don't elaborate during verification" → broke 59667, 56975.
- Keep formula/XML/CF guidance and the no-blanket-strip rule verbatim (recorded regression traps).
